Your Tropical Escape in Canggu

Experience authentic Balinese Jineng architecture blending rustic teak warmth with tropical tranquility in the heart of Canggu.

The Jineng Suite

A traditional Balinese Jineng wooden sanctuary featuring a cozy mezzanine bed loft, exposed aesthetic red brick walls, custom teak furnishings, semi-outdoor kitchenette, and seamless access to garden pathways.

Help & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions about your stay at Jineng Guest House? We've got answers.

Check-in begins at 14:00 (2:00 PM) and Check-out is until 12:00 PM (Noon). If you require early check-in or late check-out, please let us know in advance via WhatsApp and we will gladly accommodate your request based on room availability.
Each Jineng Suite comes equipped with a mezzanine king bed loft, climate-controlled Air Conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, Smart TV, solid teak wood seating lounge, private semi-outdoor kitchenette with mineral water dispenser, private bathroom with hot water, and a tropical garden veranda.
Jineng Guest House D47 is conveniently tucked away in a quiet lane in Canggu, just a 5-minute walk or short ride from Echo Beach, Pererenan, and Canggu's iconic dining spots and surf breaks.
Yes, we provide safe, complimentary parking space for motorbikes and cars right at the entrance of Jineng Guest House D47.
Simply select your Check-in and Check-out dates using the booking bar, click "Check Availability", fill in your details on the Secure Checkout page, and choose Credit Card, Bank Transfer, or QRIS E-Wallet. You can also confirm instantly with our WhatsApp admin at +62 851-1104-4817.
